notes: The shared Engine B currently attributes every pass to the declared starting quarterback and does not model CFB backup entry or blowout-driven player leashes.

The upstream SportsDataverse play_by_play release contains sportsbook-derived and spread-influenced fields. Raw PBP is provenance-only; only the exact market-blind allowlist projection may enter participation-model materialization.

The participation training clock starts only with prospective immutable captures. Existing team-level forward PIT snapshots and current release files cannot be relabeled as historical player-participation PIT evidence.
Independent forward-holdout games must start strictly after the frozen training snapshot; the snapshot itself cannot certify earlier decisions.
This registry is an engine-activation prerequisite only. It cannot create Model_P, an empirical edge floor, certification, or OFFICIAL eligibility by itself.
Sportsbook prices, public betting, capper opinions, closing lines, and spread-derived PBP fields are forbidden as participation-model features.
